evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes an exception to the main flow's transmission requirement: if the system resorts to automatic purging due to missing updates, the explicit termination message is suppressed.

evidence_cards.content: NonC2 JUs shall process J7.0 messages with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, for locally held remote tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a mandatory exception handling path (processing a drop report) specifically for NonC2 JUs, which are distinct from the primary C2 JU actor in this use case.

evidence_cards.content: Additionally, nonC2 JUs may have the capability to automatically purge locally held remote tracks, after a specified time interval, when these tracks are no longer being updated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an optional alternative/exception flow for NonC2 JUs regarding track purging based on time intervals rather than explicit message processing.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU receives a Surveillance message or a J7.0 (ACT = 1) message in which the Environment/Category and ID are different from the local data, the Environment/Category conflict shall be processed and resolved prior to the resolution of the ID conflict.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception handling sequence for conflicting track data during surveillance processing, where environment resolution takes precedence over identity resolution.

evidence_cards.content: If an Environment/Category conflict is detected, no further processing to detect an ID conflict need occur.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a conditional bypass (exception path) in the standard conflict resolution logic, preventing redundant processing when a higher-priority conflict exists.

evidence_cards.content: After a C2 JU assumes reporting responsibility (R²) for an Interface Unit (IU) that was previously dropped or inactive, the IU is reported as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG with the Identity reported as Friend.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state regarding the identity and network presence of a track immediately after the successful completion of assuming R² (which occurs when a previous holder drops the track).

evidence_cards.content: When a C2 JU assumes R² of an IU, the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator are reported as value 1, and this state shall be maintained if another C2 JU subsequently assumes R² of the IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes specific persistent attribute values (PPLI Track Number/Identity Indicator = 1) in the system state following the assumption of reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: For a remote track/point that has been automatically purged after a specified time interval, the JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state and constraint regarding message transmission following the automatic purge postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU relinquishes reporting responsibility (R²) for a real-time Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) track upon reception of a remote track report in which the remote TQ is greater than the local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific postcondition state where the initiating JU loses R² due to receiving superior data from another JU.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU relinquishes reporting responsibility (R²) for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative tie-breaking condition for the postcondition state regarding R² transfer.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU with R² on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the persistence of the 'retained responsibility' state as a default postcondition if no termination or handover occurs.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track except when that track becomes an active IU on the network with the same address as was previously being used as the reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific post-condition state for termination: the track ceases to be reported by the JU unless it transitions to an active IU status.

evidence_cards.content: For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall be transmitted at time of deactivation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the post-condition for specific track types where deactivation triggers the transmission of the drop message.

evidence_cards.content: Each system will have the capability to automatically purge those tracks (DRT = 0-3) after a specific time interval if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received and no further updates occur.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the post-condition for remote tracks in the absence of explicit termination messages: automatic purging occurs based on elapsed time.

evidence_cards.content: Under this condition [automatic purge], a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies the system state regarding message transmission during the automatic purge post-condition.

evidence_cards.content: DATUMS (DRT = 4) shall not be purged automatically.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Explicitly excludes DATUM tracks from the automatic purge post-condition.

evidence_cards.content: For the termination of a ballistic missile track where the JU currently has reporting responsibility (R²), the J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) is transmitted when the JU ceases reporting the track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the successful completion state for the explicit termination path: the transmission of the specific J7.0 (ACT=0) message serves as the postcondition indicating the track drop has been initiated.

evidence_cards.content: For remote ballistic missile tracks where no J7.0 (ACT=0) message is received and no further updates occur, the system automatically purges those tracks after a specific time interval.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the successful completion state for the automatic purge variant: the removal of the track from the system database after the timeout period constitutes the postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: NonC2 JUs may have the capability to automatically purge locally held remote tracks after a specified time interval when these tracks are no longer being updated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state resulting from the automatic purge alternative flow (postcondition: track is purged).

evidence_cards.content: The time interval for automatic purge of remote tracks is a system selected parameter.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the boundary condition/parameter governing the postcondition state change for the automatic purge variant.

evidence_cards.content: The transmission of a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message indicates that the JU has dropped or has ceased reporting the track specified in the Reference TN field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate system state resulting from the successful completion of the use case: the track is officially marked as dropped/ceased reporting by the transmitting JU.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 1) Difference Report indicating an Environment/Category conflict, the conflict shall be processed and resolved prior to the resolution of any ID conflict; if detected, no further processing to detect an ID conflict need occur.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a post-processing constraint on the system state regarding data consistency: Environment/Category conflicts must be resolved before Identity conflicts can be addressed after receiving surveillance updates.
